name: Vahlarriel's Search
summary: At the fortress, Vahlarriel Demonslayer sends you to find Dalinda and Tyranis Malem. Their search begins there as Vahlarriel alerts superiors in Darnassus. They put Dalinda’s safe return first and question Tyranis’s motives.

sections.title: A Search at the Fortress
sections.body: Vahlarriel Demonslayer asks you to seek Dalinda and Tyranis at the fortress and bring back what you learn. Vahlarriel will contact superiors in Darnassus at once. In private, they share their concern about why Tyranis came to Desolace. Above all, they want Dalinda brought home safe. Tyranis’s return can wait until they know more about him.

sections.title: A Captive's Account
sections.body:
Dalinda is held in the large building facing the entrance. She says the Burning Blade seized her and Tyranis and brought them here. She believes the cult plans to sacrifice her to its demon masters. Dalinda says the journey was a mistake from the start.

Tyranis had grown hungry for arcane lore, against his people’s wishes, and set out despite warnings of demons in Desolace. Dalinda fears what has become of him.

faq.answer: Dalinda is in the Thunder Axe Fortress area of Desolace, in the large building facing the entrance.

faq.q: Who sends you to look for Dalinda and Tyranis?
faq.answer: Vahlarriel Demonslayer asks you to find Dalinda and Tyranis at the fortress while Vahlarriel informs superiors in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why does Darnassus care more about Dalinda than Tyranis?
faq.answer: Vahlarriel’s superiors doubt Tyranis’s reasons for coming to Desolace, and they value Dalinda’s safe return above all.

faq.q: What came before this part of the search?
faq.answer: It follows the second part of Vahlarriel’s Search.
